title: Effect on other laws.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to apply to the possession, storage, sale, or use of explosives and combustibles in accordance with chapter 396.
bodyHtml: [§132D-18]  Effect on other laws.  Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to apply to the possession, storage, sale, or use of explosives and combustibles in accordance with chapter 396. [L 1994, c 180, pt of §1]
